services.name: Miami Harbor Tour
services.desc: Welcome aboard our Vintage Yacht 'Mizner's Dream'. Join us on a boat ride through the Inter Coastal Waterway (ICW) of Miami and Biscayne Bay. Our crew will share the history of Miami, its culture and how it's grown into a world renowned city. This tour includes cruising up the Miami River which is unique compared to all the other boat tours in Miami. Vessel is equipped with A/C and restroom. Activity is appropriate for all ages. Classic Boat, nastolgic tour & small group size. Conveniently located at Miami Beach Marina. Mizner's Dream is Miami Beaches only Sightseeing Vessel Beer, Wine, and Soda available for purchase (No coolers, NO outside food or beverages) Duration: 90

services.name: Vizcaya Sunset Cruise
services.desc: A truly unique and romantic way to begin your night in Miami. Come join us aboard Mizner's Dream for a sunset cruise through Biscayne Bay and to the iconic Vizcaya Mansion. Watch the sun dip behind Miami's world-class skyline. Mizner's Dream Charter's Vizcaya Wine and Cheese Sunset Cruise is unparalleled for folks who want an upscale, yet relaxed and intimate, sunset cruise. We limit capacity to 20 passengers. Cruising every Monday, Wednesday and Friday, Red and white wine. In addition, an array of quality beer, soft drinks, water and hors-d'oeuvres are also served. Key Points about this tour: One of a kind elegant cruising experience Wine and Champagne Craft and domestic beers available

services.name: Stiltsville Morning Cruise
services.desc: Embark on a memorable and stunning boat ride across Biscayne Bay to legendary Stiltsville. Glide past the Cape Florida Light House upon the turquoise waters surrounding Key Biscayne. While enjoying a light lunch tray of fruits and appetizers. From tales of gambling and debauchery in the 1930s thru 1960s, appearances on Miami Vice in the ‘80s , Stiltsville once represented the wild side of Miami.
